note: Quick, Draw! traffic light 5183299381100544. Stroke 0 is the housing: one tall box drawn from the bottom left, up the left side, across the top and down the right side, a little wider at the bottom. Strokes 1, 2 and 3 are the three lamps inside it, stacked top to bottom: a flattened box at the top (the red lamp), a round lamp in the middle (the amber lamp) and a round lamp at the bottom (the green lamp). In the film the signal hangs still, tilted about thirty degrees with its bottom to the right, and the camera shakes by a few pixels; the drawing is rigid and placed by two points, the centres of the top and bottom lamps, so it keeps its own proportions and follows the shake. Nothing in the housing moves; what changes is which lamp is lit. The amber lamp comes on at frame 3 to 4 and goes off at frame 38, and the red lamp comes on at frame 39. The lit lamps are drawn in the scene file as short rays and a few colouring-in strokes around and inside the lamp, shown only on the frames where that lamp is lit.
